Surface Dressing & Finishing Checklist 26 checkpoints across 6 sections.For seal coat, surface dressing, and chipping application on completed pavement layers Download ExcelDownload PDF **26** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per dressing section; final quality gate before traffic opening QC Engineer, Site Engineer [IS 73:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-73-2013) [SP 20:2002](https://infralens.in/code/IS-20-2002) [IS 2386:1963](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2386-Part-1-1963) Related [📐IS 73](https://infralens.in/code/IS-73) [✏️Max Aggregate Size By Member](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/max-aggregate-size-by-member) [📘Aggregate Grading (IS 383)](https://infralens.in/handbook/aggregate-grading) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. SURFACE PREPARATION | | A1 | Underlying bituminous layer inspected and approved; age ≥14 days minimum before sealing
Acceptance: Layer cured ≥14 days; completion certificate available; no visible traffic damage | Cl. 507 — Layer maturity | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Surface cleaned by mechanical broom/sweeper to remove all loose material and dust
Acceptance: Broom removal of dust, debris; <2% dust coverage visible; documented sweeping log | Cl. 507 — Surface cleaning | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Any cracks >3mm sealed with crack sealant (bituminous putty/mortar) before dressing
Acceptance: Cracks >3mm sealed; sealant flush with surface; cured before bitumen application | Cl. 507 — Crack treatment | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Potholes or soft spots filled and compacted; surface level with surrounding pavement
Acceptance: Repairs with same grade bituminous mix; level within ±5mm; compacted to match surrounding | Cl. 507 — Defect repair | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A5 | Surface moisture content <5%; no standing water visible; dry conditions confirmed
Acceptance: Visual confirmation of dry surface; no moisture sheen; applied only in dry weather | Cl. 507 — Moisture control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. BITUMEN MATERIAL & GRADE | | B1 | Bitumen grade and type approved; test certificate for penetration, softening point available
Acceptance: Grade: MC-30, MC-70, RC-2, or RC-5 (per spec); penetration/softening in range; cert <6 months | Cl. 507 — Material approval | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Bitumen temperature maintained 80-120°C (MC) or 100-140°C (RC) per grade at application
Acceptance: MC: 80-120°C; RC: 100-140°C; verified every 30 min with thermometer; logged hourly | Cl. 507 — Temperature control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Bitumen rate of application: 1.5-2.0 kg/m² for single seal; 2.5-3.5 kg/m² for double seal
Acceptance: Single: 1.5-2.0 kg/m²; Double: 2.5-3.5 kg/m²; pressure/flow meter calibrated; ±5% tolerance | Cl. 507 — Application rate control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Spray bar pressure and nozzle configuration verified before each day of work
Acceptance: Pressure: 2-3 bar; nozzles aligned; no spray overlap or gaps >100mm; test spray on dummy surface | Cl. 507 — Equipment setup | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. CHIPPING AGGREGATE QUALITY | | C1 | Aggregate source approved; grading and Los Angeles Abrasion test available
Acceptance: LAA ≤30%; grading within spec; angular particles >90%; test cert <12 months old | Cl. 507 — Material approval | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Aggregate size (chipping) per specification: 10-14mm for single seal, mixed grades for double seal
Acceptance: Single: 10-14mm; Double: 1st coat 10-14mm, 2nd coat 6-10mm; sieve analysis ±5% of spec | Cl. 507 — Aggregate sizing | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Aggregate clean, dry, and free of dust; moisture content <2%
Acceptance: Dust content <3%; moisture <2%; stockpile covered; 24-hour drying if wet | Cl. 507 — Aggregate preparation | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Flaky and elongated particles <15%; all particles angular for good adhesion
Acceptance: E&F <15%; visual confirmation of angular particles; brittle (no coating damage on chipping) | Cl. 507 — Particle shape | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C5 | Aggregate rate of application: 8-10 kg/m² for 10-14mm chipping
Acceptance: Single seal: 8-10 kg/m²; measured by hopper scale; ±10% tolerance allowed | Cl. 507 — Application rate | OK
NC
NA
